title: Stephen Colbert on The Daily Show
description: A duplicate-preserving log of retrievable YouTube uploads connected to Stephen Colbert appearances, correspondent segments, guest-host episodes, tosses, crossovers, and returns on The Daily Show.

title: Ostrich videos under 15 views
description: Public YouTube videos judged to contain an ostrich and captured while showing fewer than 15 views. The captured view count remains part of the archival record even if the video later becomes popular.
